描述_EN: the decoration was painted on the vase after the firing was done. in the han dynasty (206bc-ad220) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware. most of the coloured pigments on this vase are now lost.
描述_ZN: 该装饰是在烧制完成后画在花瓶上的。 在汉代（公元前206年-公元220年），日常用具通常是由石器制成的，埋葬的物品是由陶器制成的。 这只花瓶上的大部分彩色颜料现在已经丢失。
